name: agent-guidance-hook
description:
Enforce conversation-derived agent guidance and gating for tool use.
  Applies on SessionStart and PreToolUse to inject context and warn/block unsafe automation.

actions.message: Agent must use todo-list tracking, preface tool calls with a short status, keep messages concise, avoid revealing model or internal name, and use absolute workspace paths for edits.

actions.description: Validate that potential tool usage is gated by an explicit preamble and that absolute paths are used for edits.
